reason: I already give away free meals to creators every week and have no idea if a single customer walks in because of it. If it's free and a coupon finally tells me who actually brings people, I'll try it, and I can just send the link to the ones who DM me anyway.
objection: I don't have time to learn another app, and during the lunch rush my counter boy is not going to stop to punch in a PIN for every coupon. If the redeeming is fiddly it will die in two weeks.
would_change_my_mind: If redeeming a coupon takes more than a few seconds at the counter, or if creators keep DMing me directly instead of going through it, I'll stop using it.
